featured_reviews.name: Shuvankar Patra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience ordering from your website. This was my first time purchasing from you, and unfortunately, it has been very frustrating.

After placing the order, I called your team to request expedited delivery and agreed to pay on delivery on Thursday. I was informed that it would ship out on Friday to Kolkata. However, there were no updates until Tuesday. When I followed up, I was shocked to learn that Satguru had canceled my order without proper communication.

I placed this order because I have an international flight next week and needed to carry the item with me abroad. The delay and cancellation have put me in a very difficult situation.

Additionally, I was asked via WhatsApp to pay INR 2500 for delivery charges, even though your website clearly states free delivery. This inconsistency is unacceptable and feels misleading.

In contrast, I placed an order with The Bombay Store, and they delivered the very next day without charging any extra delivery fees. I have been their customer since 2015 and have always had a reliable experience. This situation clearly shows the difference in professionalism and customer service.

If I had been informed earlier about the issue, I would have ordered from another website and avoided this inconvenience. Because of this delay and cancellation, I am now unable to bring the Hindu deity with me as planned.

I sincerely hope you review your customer service, communication practices, and delivery policies so other customers do not face similar disappointment.

In conversation I told the lady I am going to share this matter in social media she said go head we do not care , it's ok.

Brand matters.

featured_reviews.name: Romit Mitra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've come here about seven or eight times over the last ten years for their framing services.

They are superb. Not only is their execution of the frames top notch, but what was really unexpected is the high quality of their advice while choosing framing and mounting options.

Major credit for all the art that hangs on our walls indeed go to their creators; however it's plainly acknowledged in our household that Satguru's plays a critical role for making them shine.

featured_reviews.name: Parag Sayta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had got an antique map framed at Satguru’s Andheri last year. I paid a 3x premium over local framers on the basis that I will get premium quality and service. To my shock, fungus has seeped in through the frame and spoilt the map within a year. There is no particular dampness or moisture on the wall where the map was kept.

When I went to Satguru’s Andheri, they said they can’t do anything about it and I need to visit Satguru’s Khar. At Satguru’s Khar, they said there will be an INR 5,000/- extra charge to replace the wood at the back of the frame(!). I wasn’t expecting free service, but looking to charge so much a year after I purchased the frame and making me run around from Andheri to Khar has made this a bitter experience. On top of this, there was zero sympathy or service etiquette from the owner or staff- all they were looking to do was to argue that it wasn’t their fault and they bore no responsibility for this.

I will never buy anything from Satguru’s again and would encourage others to also look at alternative options which offer better service and value than Satguru’s.

featured_reviews.review_text: A gem in the art scene, this gallery's monthly exhibitions showcase a diverse range of artists and styles. Despite its size, the space emanates charm, creating an intimate and immersive experience. Each display offers a fresh perspective, making it a must-visit for art enthusiasts seeking curated, dynamic showcases in a quaint and inviting setting.

featured_reviews.name: Saloni Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Art and Charlie in Bandra is a wonderful spot that beautifully combines art, ambiance, and culinary delights. The space itself is thoughtfully designed, offering a unique and inspiring atmosphere that is perfect for a relaxed outing.

The art keep refreshing time to time and they mention everything that is currently displayed on their Instagram profile.

One of the highlights of visiting Art and Charlie is the presence of Subko Mini, a charming little cafe that serves some of the best coffee in town. The Subko coffees are rich and flavorful, and their baked goods are equally impressive, making it a delightful stop for coffee enthusiasts and food lovers alike.

While the indoor seating at Subko Mini is quite limited, the benches outside provide a pleasant place to sit and enjoy your coffee. The service is attentive and friendly, enhancing the overall experience.

Art and Charlie is a fantastic place to visit if you're looking for a blend of good art, great coffee, and tasty baked goods. The only minor downside is the limited indoor seating at the cafe, but the quality of the offerings more than makes up for it. Highly recommended for anyone in Bandra!

featured_reviews.review_text:
An Art Studio in the Urban Jungle. Located in the Pali Village area, its a beautiful cozy structure.
My 1st visit here was to see a Musical show. Thoroughly enjoyable experience.
Very recently I happened to be there. Got to see some art works, drift woods painted in silver, a mind boggling vertical curtain with embroidered texts, which had its shadow on the back wall due to the lighting effect, uff some great memories.
Off course these are art works displayed by many artists.
Display keeps changing & so there will always be an opportunity to keep visiting Art & Charlie again & again.

customer_updates.text: This spot is truly a treasure trove! I was astounded by the sheer size of the movie and advertisement poster collection, an incredible sight to behold. He is working to preserve what makes both Bombay and cinema culture unique and experiential. Visit him for an evening of wonderful recommendations and beautiful posters. You won’t regret it.

featured_reviews.review_text: The store is beautiful, amazing variety of posters, great condition as well. Hinesh took us through a range of posters, educating us on the movies and telling us great trivia about the movies as well, highly recommend coming to this store if you're a movie buff or just appreciate art.

featured_reviews.name: Bharath Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience! Hinesh and Jitu were extremely knowledgeable and accommodating. It felt like a time machine going through the various eras of Bollywood. Hinesh took the time to explain the significance of the art, as well as of the films themselves. If you are a cinephile or a fan of unique art pieces, I absolutely recommend checking Indian Hippy out!

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Ravi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stopped by on two different occasions to browse the vintage Hollywood posters and ads they have in store.

Thw owner, Hinesh,  and his team was incredibly patient, especially since I had told them upfront that I wasn’t sure what I wanted and was just looking around.

Their collection is fantastic; original Hollywood posters ranging from films of the 1930s to more modern classics. Prices vary widely too, from around ₹500 to a few thousands.

I ended up picking up a vintage Alfred Hitchcock poster and a Charlie Chaplin poster, both of which I’m excited to frame and put up at home.

The staff was never pushy, just helpful, making the whole experience genuinely enjoyable.

I’d highly recommend this store if you’re looking to own original vintage movie posters and memorabilia.

featured_reviews.name: Inan Chowdhury
featured_reviews.review_text: Such an amazing collection, we felt like we were in a museum. The shop owner was super helpful and knowledgeable about each piece. We ended up buying 3-4 posters but enjoyed looking at each individually. All different sizes available as well

featured_reviews.name: Alan Meades
featured_reviews.review_text:
I found this place through a Google search as I was planning to visit the Mumbai Bollywood poster museum. Instead of going to the museum I decided to go to Indian Hippy (on the hill to the left) and was absolutely thrilled.

Such a brilliant collection of posters, great hospitality and so much knowledge. I left very happy having bought quite a few posters and having seen so many more and learned so much.

I could have spent hours here quite easily.

If you're into posters, graphic design, illustration, Bollywood, or design more generally, then I think this might be the place for you. A wonderful shop and a wonderful experience.

And: posters very well packed in heavy duty tubes.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Gajjar
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my first time buying a vintage poster for a friend, and honestly, it turned into so much more than just a purchase. We ended up having a great conversation about the history of Bollywood and how these posters were actually made back in the day.

Apart from buying the poster, I walked away with a deeper appreciation for the legacy of Indian cinema it felt like a full experience rather than a transaction. I’d 100% recommend this to filmmakers, film geeks, or anyone who loves cinema.

100/100 for the experience and entertainment, and 1000/1000 for the buying experience. 🎬

featured_reviews.name: Hemang
featured_reviews.review_text:
This store is epic! Make sure to come by here if you have any interest in Bollywood films and vintage movie posters.

It’s a nondescript store behind a clothing shop, so make sure to peek through the driveway for the fun logo of the man with a mustache. I shared a photo of the outside.

The owner, Hiresh, is super informative and friendly and PATIENT. We spent over 1.5 hours here going through all the posters he has to sell. People who are passion about their business really inspire us and we’re so happy we purposefully came here to shop.

We ultimately picked two versions of a movie called “Barsaat,” and he is so nice that he will courier it to our residence tonight as well as we have to fly back home to the states tomorrow. Support Hiresh so he can continue selling these posters and inspire film fanatics and art collectors.

We look forward to framing both of our new posters and hanging them in our home.

I would like to share a very bad experience with the Fabindia recently !!
On 10th Dec I bought bath towels and hand towels from Fabindia Khar West branch worth INR 6,000 plus.
